rationale.correct: Using Sabine's formula (metric): A = 0.161V/RT. Current absorption = 0.161×600/1.8 = 96.6/1.8 = 53.7 sabins. Target absorption = 0.161×600/0.75 = 96.6/0.75 = 128.8 sabins. Additional absorption required = 128.8 − 53.7 = 75.1 ≈ 75 sabins.
rationale.takeaway: Restaurants and cafeterias need RT60 of 0.6-0.9s per acoustic standards. Use Sabine's formula (A = 0.161V/RT60 in metric) to calculate required absorption by finding the difference between current and target total absorption.
